rulings.restated: Input — The costs incurred for qualified long-term care services provided for this person during the days of the LTC period (necessary diagnostic, preventive, therapeutic, treating and rehabilitative services, and maintenance or personal care, under a plan of care prescribed by a licensed health care practitioner); zero if none
rulings.model: The instructions define qualified LTC services as "necessary diagnostic, preventive, therapeutic, curing, treating, mitigating, and rehabilitative services, and maintenance or personal care services required to treat a chronically ill individual." The restatement drops "curing" and "mitigating" and the condition "required to treat a chronically ill individual," which can change which costs are entered.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; i8853 p. 9, Line 22: 'necessary diagnostic, preventive, therapeutic, curing, treating, mitigating, and rehabilitative services, and maintenance or personal care services required to treat a chronically ill individual under a plan of care prescribed by a licensed health care practitioner'. The question drops 'curing', 'mitigating' and 'required to treat a chronically ill individual', so a filer can leave out qualifying costs (BUG-0916).

rulings.restated: Subtract helper "Line 24, asked only when line 20 is more than zero (zero otherwise)" from line 23. If zero or less, enter -0-.
rulings.model: The form says only "Per diem limitation. Subtract line 24 from line 23" and gives no zero floor. The restatement adds "If zero or less, enter -0-," which changes line 26 whenever line 24 exceeds line 23.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; f8853 line 25 prints 'Subtract line 24 from line 23' with no floor (line 26 has one); the project floors line 25 at zero, a reading recorded in no ambiguity entry. It differs only when reimbursements exceed line 23, where the printed form would tax more than the payments received; the floor is the sensible reading but must be registered (BUG-0917).
